get_currency_rates.note: Legacy poe.ninja route removed; reference rates stay an independent economy feature and are not executable listings.

find_arbitrage.note: Legacy route with the reversed pay/receive interpretation removed; bounded screening covers all two-currency loops and keeps three-currency loops on the first 20 names.

calculate_trading_profit.note: Legacy profit verdict removed; chain simulation reports reference conversion and incomplete chains without claiming executable profit.

start_watching.note: Legacy auto-reloading watcher removed; the replacement observes files without importing or mutating any snapshot.

stop_watching.note: Legacy watcher control removed; the replacement stops the independent observer and keeps recorded events for this process.

get_recent_changes.note: Legacy unbounded recent-change list removed; the replacement returns ordered bounded events with a session-bound cursor and overflow indicator.

watch_status.note: Legacy status report removed; the replacement reports process-local state, directory, cursor and error.

classify_item_affixes.note: Legacy text route removed; the replacement keeps hybrid and unmatched-line regressions, withholds slot counts unless confirmed, and reports matched lines that exceed rarity capacity.

list_craftable_mods.note: Legacy route removed; the replacement separates within-level and level-locked bench crafts and paginates them.

find_affix_tiers.note: Legacy route removed; the replacement keeps zero-weight and Elevated candidates, complete-tag spawn rules, item-level filtering and the base-tag vocabulary.
